{{Top|leg}}
The '''Wistie language''' was [[Language/Legends|spoken]] by the [[Wistie/Legends|Wisties]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of tiny, radiant [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="CotT">{{Ewoks|The Cries of the Trees}}</ref> It consisted in buzzing, squeakings sounds,<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> and it was possible for members of other species to understand it fluently.<ref name="CotT" />
